interface.longDescription: Unbound — from Uncompany is a self-serve preview of a sales playbook in motion. It turns calls and unanswered emails into grounded drafts for a rep to review. Unbound is the preview; the install is the product. The rep selects the work and approves every exact external payload — nothing is sent on its own.
